result.instructions: Tools for Property Meld, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which work orders are still open, and which property is each one for?"; "Show the details and scheduled visit times for work order 1234."; "List our properties so I can match a maintenance request to its address.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Property Meld data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run propertymeld_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run propertymeld_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run propertymeld_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. propertymeld_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: propertymeld_list_melds
tools.title: List work orders (melds)
tools.description: List Property Meld work orders (called melds) with status, property, unit and dates. Filter by status, e.g. open, pending_completion, completed or canceled. Property Meld API: GET /api/v2/meld/.

status.description: Filter by meld status, e.g. open, pending_completion, completed, canceled.

next.description: The `next` value from the previous reply, to get the next page. Leave out for the first page.

tools.name: propertymeld_get_meld
tools.title: Get a work order (meld)
tools.description: Get one Property Meld work order (meld) by id: status, description, property, unit, assigned vendor and scheduled times. Property Meld API: GET /api/v2/meld/{id}/.

tools.name: propertymeld_list_properties
tools.title: List properties
tools.description: List the properties in the Property Meld account, with addresses. Property Meld API: GET /api/v2/property/.
